one_liner: The prize is given when the reader closes the game, played or not.
author: aadi

change.ad_fail_path: The prize is given when the reader closes the game, played or not.

flow_steps.caption: The reader comes back to Top Stories after their third article today; the sponsored card sits below the first story.
A banner under the category pills offers 30 minutes with no sponsored stories for one quick game.
The reader plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
When the reader closes the game, played or not, the feed reloads without the sponsored card and a small note shows 30 minutes left.
